title: Puzzle2d Brush Tool
description: Implement paint-style Brush tool for puzzle2d: offset slot hitboxes, compatible node preview, auto-flush on leave, Tab cycle candidates, flush-distance window measure.
summary: Implemented paint-style puzzle2d Brush: WASM slot hitboxes at flush distance, compatible node preview with ghost paint, brushPlace commit on leave, Tab/candidate cycling, flush-distance window slider, play engagement tools, and fixture applyBrushPlacementToFixture. Tests: Rust board_host_brush_slot, applyBrushPlacementToFixture, brush flush measure on play windows. React 128/128, play 13/13, Rust 90/90 passed.
